#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

long long go(long long n, long long m) {
    if (n > m) {
        swap(n, m);
    }
    long long o = n * m;
    if (n <= 3 && m <= 3) {
        if (n == 1 || m == 1) return 0;
        if (n == 2 && m == 2) return 0;
        if (n == 2 && m == 3) return 4;
        if (n == 3 && m == 2) return 4;
        if (n == 3 && m == 3) return 8;
        return 0;
    }
    if (n == 1) {
        m = m % 6;
        if (m == 4) m = 2;
        else if (m == 5) m = 1;
        return o - m;
    } else if (n == 2) {
        if (m == 3 || m == 7) m = 2;
        else m = 0;
        return o - m;
    }
    return o - o % 2;
}

int main() {
    long long n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    long long rs = go(n, m);
    cout << rs << endl;
    return 0;
}
